experiment: V43 threshold grid, shared-model/local-calibration deployment configurations, and machine-life-experiment statistics

frozen_v29b_policy.origin: frozen V29b source policy, unchanged since V41/V42; strong and vote_fraction are never adjusted by V43, only the moderate/nominal-z lever is swept (SS2.1) and, for arms with EPC on, bootstrap-adjusted (SS3, carried from V42)

local_model.note: SPEC-AMBIGUITY (see raw_online_federated_v43_grid.py module docstring): V43_PREREGISTRATION.md SS2.2 does not specify what a 'purely local model' consists of. The most literal reading that requires NO retraining is V41/V42's own already-computed per-device local-PCA comparator (models.fit_pca on that device's own 12-point FIT window, a closed-form per-device fit that was already part of the frozen scoring pipeline, not a newly trained model). Used as a single-branch ensemble (weight 1.0) through the same calib.ensemble_decision/latch machinery as the federated arms.

persistence.note: 4-of-7 latch throughout, delegated to raw_online_federated_v25_policy.latch_stream, unchanged from V41R1/V42

epc.note: identical B/p/seed to V42 so that the seed-derivation function raw_online_federated_v42._seed_for(seed, client_id, branch, m) reproduces V42's own bootstrap draws bit-for-bit at m=64, nominal z=2.0 -- required for gate G1

commissioning.rationale: input_calibration and local_healthy_fitting stay fixed; only the score-calibration window m varies. Geometry constants are imported from raw_online_federated_v42_calibration (FIT_END, GUARD_SIZE), not redefined.

threshold_grid.note: SS2.1: the FULL trade curve is the deliverable. No point on this grid may be nominated as a winner; the grid is reported in ascending z order.

m_sensitivity.note: SS2.3, secondary only. Fixed on the common cohort eligible at all three sizes so changing eligibility cannot distort the comparison. SPEC-AMBIGUITY: SS2.3 does not name a threshold for this leg; the frozen V29b nominal moderate (2.0) is used, matching the F-L definition (device-local EPC threshold) and V42's own primary comparison point, so only m varies.

deployment_configurations.note: F-G vs F-L isolates the calibration problem, a clean contrast (same model, threshold style only). F-L vs L-L is RETAINED as the deployment comparison (best shared configuration vs best local configuration) but is CONFOUNDED as an isolation of federated representation learning -- see matched_algorithm_pair below (SS2.2.1, added after review) for the actual isolation. F-L is the intended deployment (SS2.2). The (local_pca16, global-threshold, no-EPC) combination is not one of the three named configurations and is not computed (task-scope instruction: do not add mechanisms the preregistration does not describe).

matched_algorithm_pair.note: SS2.2.1 (added after review, MANDATORY): F-L uses the three-branch V29b triad while the only available local comparator is single-branch local PCA-16, so F-L vs L-L varies training locality AND branch count at once and cannot by itself isolate the value of federated representation learning. FED_PCA16 is already computed as a separate branch (raw_online_federated_v42_calibration.BRANCHES), so this matched pair costs nothing: F-L(PCA) is the FED_PCA16 branch ALONE with a device-local EPC threshold (reuses F-L's own per-branch EPC-adjusted threshold, no new bootstrap draw); L-L(PCA) is local PCA-16 with a device-local EPC threshold, numerically IDENTICAL to L-L (the chosen local model already is local PCA-16) but reported under its own config label. Same algorithm, same branch count, same threshold style -- only training locality differs. This pair, not F-L vs L-L, is the isolation of federated representation learning, reported with a matched-pair confidence interval on the F-L(PCA) minus L-L(PCA) difference, clustered on machine-life experiment (raw_online_federated_v43_stats.matched_pair_bootstrap). Context: memory.txt Appendix 2026-08-01 records federated PCA-16 as the one arm that improved first-alarm timing on the fresh cohort (26/35 valid, fewest premature).

onset_tolerance.note: SS3.2: an alarm within tau of remaining life before the annotated onset still counts as valid at that tolerance. Reported as a four-point band, secondary/proxy-dependent.

bootstrap.note: SS3.4: resampling occurs at experiment level -- an IMS experiment enters or leaves a resample with all of its bearings together. Unit-tested (raw_online_federated_v43_stats_tests.py) that no resample ever contains a partial experiment.

cohort.note: SS1.2/1.3, verified 2026-08-05 (memory.txt Appendix 2026-08-05). IMS's 12 streams are 3 simultaneous-recording experiments (4 bearings per shaft/housing under one radial load); every other historical dataset here records one bearing per independent machine-life experiment.

lorawan.source: constants carried unchanged from raw_online_federated_v39_protocol.DRAFT.json 'lorawan' block; airtime formula reused from raw_online_federated_v39_comm.py (not reimplemented)

radio_energy_assumption.note: ESTIMATED, not measured on real hardware -- published typical SX1276-class transceiver current at +14 dBm TX / continuous RX (datasheet order-of-magnitude figures). memory.txt already records measured on-hardware latency/RAM/flash/energy as UNADDRESSED; this Leg 4 accounting is a declared estimate, consistent with V39/V40's prior communication-accounting exercises, and must be reported as such.

model.note: V43 performs no gradient compression (that is V39/V40's scope); the shared triad model (PCA-16 + AE + Deep-SVDD, 12,080 float32 parameters = 48,320 bytes, computed from the frozen all_source.npz bundle) is transmitted uncompressed in both directions each round.

scenarios.physical_node: one machine or test assembly is one federated node; multiple bearings on one shaft/housing (IMS) are local sensor channels on that one node's radio
scenarios.bearing_client: one bearing stream is one logical federated client (matches how the historical 40-source triad was actually trained); valid only as a simulation assumption or where hardware genuinely gives each bearing its own processor and radio
scenarios.note: SS4: communication cost follows the physical endpoint (node count from the physical_node scenario where stated); statistical intervals and effective sample size always follow the machine-life experiment (raw_online_federated_v43_stats.py). These two counts are never the same for IMS and must never be interchanged.

gate.note: SS5: there is no single-operating-point performance pass/fail gate on the threshold grid -- nominating a winner post hoc is exactly what SS2.1 forbids.
gate.G1: arm reproducing V42's m=64/z=2.0/EPC configuration (F-L, calibration_points=64, nominal_z=2.00, epc=true) matches V42 frozen2's C_EPC_ADJUSTED/64 arm exactly on every shared device (first_alarm)
gate.G2: no bearings from one simultaneous experiment split across a partition or bootstrap resample -- verified structurally for every one of the 10,000 resamples, not sampled
gate.G3: every reported table states both the stream count and the machine-life-experiment count denominators
gate.G4: specificity (P1) computed over verified-healthy devices only; censored/confounded devices reported in a clearly separated INCONCLUSIVE panel, never pooled into a specificity rate
gate.G5: no onset artifact read before the prediction lock; no target (DLR) data ever opened
gate.failure_action: write the complete report, all tables, and all figures, then exit 2

secondary_endpoint_caveat: premature/valid/late/missed against the analytical onset reference is proxy-dependent; the premature fraction moves from 23% to 97% purely with the commissioning rule (memory.txt Appendix 2026-07-27B) and every table carrying these labels must repeat this caveat, alongside the four-point onset-tolerance band (tau in {0,5%,10%,20%})
